svg.aria-label: Keeping watch on AI. A burst chart of the SafeAI.watch record: 752 dated, sourced entries from Mar 2023 to Nov 2026, one dot each: 145 warnings, 192 incidents, 190 governance, 225 research. Distance from the centre is the entry's date; dashed rings mark January 1. The record is a selection, so density shows what it covers, not how often things happen.
